meta.title.hr: Buffet Kod Baje — Domaća kuhinja u Drnišu
meta.title.en: Buffet Kod Baje — Homemade cuisine in Drniš

meta.description.hr: Tradicionalni restoran u srcu Drniša. Domaća hrana, drniški pršut i ruralni ugođaj.
meta.description.en: Traditional restaurant in the heart of Drniš. Homemade food, Drniš pršut, and rustic charm.

hero.tagline.en: Homemade cuisine in the heart of Drniš

about.text1.hr: Buffet Kod Baje je tradicionalni restoran smješten u srcu Drniša, gdje se od davnina njeguje ljubav prema domaćoj hrani i iskrenom gostoprimstvu.
about.text1.en: Buffet Kod Baje is a traditional restaurant located in the heart of Drniš, where a love for homemade food and genuine hospitality has been cherished for generations.

about.text2.hr: Kod nas nema pretjerivanja — samo poštena, domaća kuhinja pripremljena od svježih, lokalnih namirnica. Naš drniški pršut, sušen na hladnoj buri, ponos je ovoga kraja.
about.text2.en: Here, there's no fuss — just honest, homemade cooking prepared from fresh, local ingredients. Our Drniš pršut, cured in the cold bura wind, is the pride of this region.

about.text3.hr: Dođite kao gost, odlazite kao prijatelj. Uz retro atmosferu i toplinu doma, svaki obrok postaje iskustvo.
about.text3.en: Come as a guest, leave as a friend. With a retro atmosphere and the warmth of home, every meal becomes an experience.

contact.note.hr: Nalazimo se u blizini glavnog trga u Drnišu.
contact.note.en: We are located near the main square in Drniš.
